scope: L0 finite-catalogue geometric sensing with real robot static endpoint queries; selected native execution is a separate L1 validation, never inferred from q_solution.
context_selection: public nominal and body-z displacement stress, both robot-valid in frozen task-free capability manifest; no B rewards used for selection

motion.source: actual DMP_playground.dmp_honest.dmp.fit_discrete_dmp + rollout, linear endpoint calibration shared by all methods

task.public_stop_primary: same five-frame image verifier for every method; hidden audit never grants retry
task.correct_audit: same frames actual target,15mm physical connected length,2mm center,10deg axis-plane,contact

planner.task_risk: expected correct-public-stop probability; wrong public stop charged same60 as timeout
planner.candidate_family_future: same public-history continuous candidate generator at hypothetical public history
planner.no_future_cap: ignores future endpoint-search availability only; same hard execution check retained
planner.dird: proxy used for same-task tie preference/query ordering, never changes anatomy or replaces robot checks

endpoints.static_query: finite all-eight-branch robot FK/URDF/35-pair checks; per-pose fixed witness from public scene start seed, memoized identically for all methods
endpoints.not_found: bounded search failure, not physical impossibility
endpoints.q_kin: fixed static endpoint witness planning state only
endpoints.q_out: reserved for actual native executed continuation state
endpoints.joint_time: declared estimate from real joint displacement/vmax, compared separately to native subset

evaluation.cluster_unit: hidden catalogue object, paired across contexts and methods

negative_controls: uninformative sensor in exact operator tests
high observation cost in exact operator tests
no ability conflict or all endpoints found
release: dev runs allowed; root/audit review before test rollout; numeric changes after dev require recorded amendment before opening test
